Inspect the supplied codebase and identify its core component: the connected set of responsibilities around which the application's main behavior and state are organized. Generate a single ASCII tree diagram showing that core component, its main parts, and their relationships. Choose the scope and level of detail that best explain the codebase. Ground the diagram in the source code.

Here is the "3+1" model of conceptual codebase models:
1. [REPLACED] Containment	      where code lives
2. [REPLACED] Lexical scope	    which names code can see
  -> *collapse* into 1. Modular structure
    I want to collapse Containment / Lexical scope into a single category, called modular structure, which:
    - abstracts out the source file level organization
      - but retains boundaries and visibility: what a component exposes versus keeps internal
    - retains dependency graph
    - groups components into higher level, logic-semantical categorizations
3. Call (dynamic)     which activation invoked which
4. Ownership          responsibility for state, storage, resources, and their lifetimes: who creates, retains, changes, or releases them
1. [SPECIAL] Data dependency   is a different kind of thing. It isn’t a fifth organizational choice; it is the record of what actually needs what for the program to compute its result. It’s a graph, and it exists before you decide how to organize anything.

Keep the following in mind when generating your diagram:
  - there should be 60/40 between code refs and nat lang

Few-shot examples (synthetic style references, not source facts):
Example 1: Incremental compiler
Incremental compiler -- reuse follows the module dependency graph
|
|-- [M] BuildGraph connects source modules to their compilation artifacts
|   |-- modules[moduleId]: ModuleUnit
|   |   |-- sourceHash -> immutable source bytes
|   |   |-- imports[] -> resolved module identities
|   |   `-- interfaceHash -> names and types visible to consumers
|   `-- units[unitId]: AnalysisUnit
|       |-- mutually dependent modules share one unit
|       `-- dependencies[] -> units whose interfaces must be available first
|
|-- [C] compileUnit(unitId) resolves one reusable result
|   |-- [D] member source hashes + dependency interfaces + compiler options
|   |   `-- analysisKey, including the compiler implementation version
|   |-- ArtifactCache.lookup(analysisKey)
|   |   |-- Hit -> recover typed modules and diagnostics
|   |   `-- Miss -> analyze the unit
|   |       |-- [C] Parser.parse(source) -> syntax with source spans
|   |       |-- [C] Binder.bind(syntax, dependencyInterfaces)
|   |       |   `-- Scope
|   |       |       |-- declarations[name] -> local Symbol
|   |       |       |-- parent -> enclosing lexical scope
|   |       |       `-- exports -> symbols visible across the module boundary
|   |       `-- [C] TypeChecker.check(boundUnit) -> typed modules + diagnostics
|   `-- Successful analysis -> Emitter.emit(typedModules, target)
|       |-- [D] typed modules + target version + emission options -> objectKey
|       `-- ObjectArtifact
|           |-- object code / exported interface / source map
|           `-- [O] ArtifactCache retains complete immutable entries
|               `-- consumers borrow artifacts; eviction follows cache policy
|
|-- [C] rebuild(changedPaths) propagates only relevant changes
|   |-- Capture new source hashes and resolve changed imports
|   |   `-- [D] updated graph -> regroup cycles and order affected units
|   |-- Reanalyze affected units
|   |   |-- Exported interface changed -> invalidate dependent analysis keys
|   |   `-- Interface unchanged -> consumers can reuse their typed modules
|   `-- [D] reachable object hashes + runtime + linker options -> bundleKey
|       `-- Linker.link(objects) produces the executable bundle
|           `-- changed implementation can require linking without retyping consumers
|
`-- [O] BuildScheduler controls transient execution
    |-- ready queue -> units whose dependency results are available
    |   `-- independent units may run concurrently
    |-- running[unitId] -> task + worker lease
    |   |-- [C] invoke compileUnit(unitId)
    |   `-- task settlement returns the worker lease
    |-- cancel(buildId)
    |   `-- stop scheduling -> signal tasks -> await settlement -> release snapshot
    `-- BuildResult retains bundle references and source-located diagnostics
        `-- [D] diagnostic spans + captured sources -> stable reported locations

Example 2: Telemetry ingestion service
Telemetry ingestion service
|
|-- [M] IngestGateway accepts batches from device connections
|   |-- accept(connection, envelope): BatchReceipt
|   |   |-- [D] credentials + device registry -> authorized tenant/device
|   |   `-- [C] decode -> validate envelope -> PartitionRouter.route(batch)
|   |       |-- Partition key = tenantId + deviceId
|   |       `-- One device's batches reach the same ordered partition
|   |-- [O] Retains connection state until disconnect
|   |   |-- pending[batchId] -> receipt waiter
|   |   `-- socket close detaches waiters; accepted work can still finish
|   `-- Admission limit
|       |-- available capacity -> enqueue batch
|       `-- full partition queue -> return retryable rejection
|
|-- [O] PartitionWorker owns one partition's ingestion progress
|   |-- Retained state
|   |   |-- queue: BoundedQueue<AcceptedBatch>
|   |   |   `-- accepted batches wait here before processing
|   |   |-- checkpoint: PartitionCheckpoint
|   |   |   |-- partitionId / committedOffset
|   |   |   `-- lastSequence[deviceId] -> latest committed device sequence
|   |   `-- lease: PartitionLease
|   |       |-- ownerId / epoch / expiresAt
|   |       `-- [D] current epoch -> authority to commit new progress
|   |
|   |-- [C] run() drains the queue one batch at a time
|   |   `-- process(batch)
|   |       |-- Establish batch identity
|   |       |   |-- key = tenantId + deviceId + batchId
|   |       |   `-- [C] EventStore.lookupReceipt(key)
|   |       |       |-- Same payload hash -> return committed receipt
|   |       |       |-- Different payload hash -> reject identity conflict
|   |       |       `-- Missing receipt -> prepare a new commit
|   |       |
|   |       |-- Normalize measurements
|   |       |   `-- [C] SchemaRegistry.resolve(batch.schemaVersion)
|   |       |       |-- [M] Exposes versioned field and unit definitions
|   |       |       `-- [D] raw samples + exact schema -> Measurement[]
|   |       |           |-- identity: tenantId / deviceId / sequence
|   |       |           |-- observation: timestamp / metric / value / unit
|   |       |           `-- provenance: batchId / schemaVersion / payloadHash
|   |       |
|   |       |-- Check sequence continuity
|   |       |   |-- [D] firstSequence + checkpoint.lastSequence[deviceId]
|   |       |   |   `-- next expected sequence or a detected gap
|   |       |   |-- Contiguous -> stage measurements
|   |       |   `-- Gap or overlap -> reject without advancing checkpoint
|   |       |
|   |       `-- Commit and acknowledge
|   |           |-- [C] EventStore.commit(batch, checkpoint, lease.epoch)
|   |           |   |-- [D] measurements + batch identity + next checkpoint
|   |           |   |   `-- one durable transaction
|   |           |   `-- Stale lease epoch -> reject the former owner
|   |           `-- After confirmed commit
|   |               |-- Install returned checkpoint
|   |               `-- Resolve gateway waiters with BatchReceipt
|   |                   `-- receipt confirms storage, not downstream indexing
|   |
|   `-- Lease loss or shutdown
|       |-- [C] Stop admission and stop dequeuing new work
|       |-- In-flight commit may have an uncertain outcome
|       |   `-- retry resolves through its durable batch receipt
|       `-- [O] Release queue entries and detach remaining waiters
|           `-- next owner restores progress from EventStore
|
|-- [M] EventStore binds stored events to durable progress
|   |-- [M] Exposes commit / lookupReceipt / restoreCheckpoint / scan
|   |-- Internal transaction
|   |   |-- Verify current partition lease epoch
|   |   |-- Append measurements with partition offsets
|   |   |-- Insert receipt under the unique batch identity
|   |   `-- Advance PartitionCheckpoint in the same commit
|   |       `-- failure rolls back events, receipt and checkpoint together
|   |-- [O] Retains the durable event log and retry receipts
|   |   |-- worker restarts leave both intact
|   |   `-- receipt retention defines the supported retry horizon
|   `-- scan(partitionId, afterOffset): EventPage
|       `-- [D] committed log + cursor -> ordered events and next cursor
|
`-- [M] ProjectionHost maintains independently rebuildable read models
    |-- [O] consumers[name]: ProjectionConsumer
    |   |-- cursor[partitionId] -> last applied event offset
    |   |-- handler: ProjectionHandler
    |   `-- cancellation + poll subscription
    |
    |-- Registered consumers
    |   |-- LatestReading
    |   |   |-- [D] device/metric + sequence -> newest accepted value
    |   |   `-- older replayed events cannot replace a newer reading
    |   `-- HourlySummary
    |       |-- [D] metric + observation timestamp -> aggregation bucket
    |       `-- count / sum / minimum / maximum
    |           `-- late observations update their original time bucket
    |
    |-- [C] poll() -> EventStore.scan() -> handler.apply(page)
    |   `-- Projection transaction
    |       |-- Apply only offsets beyond the stored consumer cursor
    |       `-- Save changed rows and cursor atomically
    |           `-- crash before commit -> safely read the same page again
    |
    `-- rebuild(name, newVersion)
        |-- [O] Create separate projection tables and fresh cursors
        |-- [C] Replay retained events while the current version serves reads
        `-- [D] rebuilt cursors + captured log positions -> readiness
            `-- switch readers after catch-up; retire the previous tables

Use the examples as a varied pool of representational choices. Let the supplied evidence determine depth, branching, density, and relationship types; do not copy their domain facts, exact shapes, counts, or require every tag.

Return a JSON object with exactly one field, "ascii", containing the diagram string. Return exactly one ASCII tree with one root, printable ASCII characters, spaces and LF newlines. No Markdown fences or surrounding prose. The complete tree must fit within 20000 characters. Do not add separate side diagrams.

import type { CanvasHistoryService } from '../../../../domain/core/diagrams/canvasHistoryService';
import type { WorkspaceStorage } from '../workspace/workspaceStorage';
import { createContext, useContext } from 'react';
import type { DiagramGenerator } from '../../../../domain/core/diagrams/diagramGeneration';
import type { CodeRepoService } from '../../../../domain/core/source/codeRepoService';

export interface MappingServices { diagramGenerator: DiagramGenerator; canvasHistory: CanvasHistoryService; codeRepo: CodeRepoService; workspaceStorage?: WorkspaceStorage }
export const MappingServicesContext = createContext<MappingServices | null>(null);
export function useMappingServices(): MappingServices {
  const services = useContext(MappingServicesContext);
  if (!services) throw new Error('Mapping services must be injected by MappingPocPage');
  return services;
}

|
|-- [M] Application entry and lifetime
|   |   src/app/App.tsx; src/features/mapping/MappingPage.tsx
|   |-- App -> MappingPocPage -> MappingWorkspacePage
|   |   `-- Default application surface; /evals is a separate consumer of services
|   |-- createMappingServices() -> MappingServicesContext
|   |   `-- canvasHistory / diagramGenerator / codeRepo / workspaceStorage
|   `-- [O] CanvasWorkspace owns drafts[documentId] and controllers Map
|       |   src/features/mapping/workspace/canvasWorkspace.ts
|       |-- setDrafts() creates CanvasSession from document + canvas + history
|       |-- DraftMetadata retains name, repositoryId, saved baseline and viewport
|       |-- onPersist(ids) reports affected documents, not a whole-workspace snapshot
|       `-- Replacing/removing a session unsubscribes and calls session.dispose()
|
|-- [O] CanvasSession -- one document's command facade and observable state
|   |   src/features/mapping/workspace/canvasSession.ts
|   |-- Owns MappingDocumentController and CanvasCursorCopy
|   |-- readable() exposes getState / getInitialState / subscribe, not store mutation
|   |-- Separate stores prevent unrelated consumers from sharing every update
|   |   |-- document -> MappingGridDocument
|   |   |-- presentation -> display + diagramViews
|   |   |-- selection / controls -> membership and active interaction surfaces
|   |   `-- geometry / status -> measurements, version, dirty and undo flags
|   |-- Controller subscription publishes changes synchronously
|   |   `-- canvasRevisionId changed -> onCommit() -> workspace persistence listeners
|   `-- [D] Current scene/edges/name + saved baseline -> isDirty / sceneDirty
|       `-- updateBaseline() records the acknowledged save, not later unsaved edits
|
|-- [M] Semantic document model -- composition, content and view are distinct
|   |-- MappingGridDocument [domain/mapping/workspace/mappingGrid.ts]
|   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene [domain/core/diagrams/lineGrid.ts]
|   |   |   |-- root: GridBox -> nested containers and positioned diagram instances
|   |   |   `-- contents[contentId]: Diagram <- diagram boxes reference contentId
|   |   |-- edges: DiagramConnection[] / jumps -> connections and navigation
|   |   `-- alternatives / revisionSelections / revisionReviews / diagramContexts
|   |       `-- Review choices and generation context belong to the canvas document
|   |
|   |-- Diagram [domain/core/diagrams/diagram.ts]
|   |   |-- diagramId / revisionId -> stable identity and exact content version
|   |   |-- content: DiagramContent -> ASCII, hash, parser version and structure
|   |   |   `-- buildDiagramContent() validates ASCII; tree structure retains node IDs
|   |   |-- sourceContext -> binding + contentHash + mappings + evidence
|   |   |   `-- [D] mapping.entityId + sourceRangeIndex -> evidence source range
|   |   `-- diagramSource().forSelection() / entries() / search()
|   |       `-- Read-only joins connect diagram regions to repository evidence
|   |
|   `-- MappingCanvasState [domain/mapping/workspace/mappingWorkspace.ts]
|       |-- selection.items / controls / display / diagramViews / viewport
|       |-- DisplayState holds projection panes and conversations
|       `-- [D] Content + presentation choices + collapsed nodes -> visible scene
|           |   domain/mapping/workspace/diagramViewState.ts
|           |-- presentationScene() -> resolveDiagramView()
|           `-- projectDiagramContent() maps visible rows back to source lines
|               `-- Folding changes presentation, not the stored ASCII
|
|-- [C] MappingDocumentController -- shared semantic mutation boundary
|   |   domain/mapping/workspace/mappingDocumentController.ts
|   |-- Public commands: applyUpdate / transact / select / updateCanvas / undo
|   |   `-- UI edits, native gestures and agent requests converge here
|   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, DiagramOperation[])
|   |   |-- settlePendingGesture() through an attached editor driver
|   |   |-- expectedVersion != snapshot.version -> VERSION_CONFLICT
|   |   |-- Stage operations against a cloned document/canvas
|   |   |   |-- diagram-create / patchDiagram / replace / diagram-revision-apply
|   |   |   |-- move / duplicate-instance / group / delete-diagrams
|   |   |   `-- highlight / setSourceMappings / edge-* / variant-* / alternative-*
|   |   `-- updateSnapshot(next, record=true)
|   |       |-- Reconcile connections and jumps; validate connections
|   |       |-- Normalize selection and diagram views; resolve floating geometry
|   |       |-- historyService.append(context, document, canvas, node correspondence)
|   |       `-- Publish new version/checkpoint -> CanvasSession subscribers
|   |-- updateCanvas(..., record=false) can publish transient state without history
|   `-- getSnapshot() / nodes() / persistenceChanges() expose derived read boundaries
|       `-- History storage and diagram revision tables remain behind services
|
|-- [O] CanvasHistoryService -- authoritative semantic checkpoint archive
|   |   domain/core/diagrams/canvasHistoryService.ts; canvasHistory.ts
|   |-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService.contexts: WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>
|   |   `-- openContext() isolates viewers; unreachable handles permit collection
|   |-- CanvasHistoryRecord
|   |   |-- headId / baselineId / past[] / future[] -> checkpoint navigation
|   |   |-- snapshots[id]: StoredCanvasSnapshot
|   |   |   |-- document: CanvasDocument -> composition without embedded contents
|   |   |   |-- diagramBindings -> exact revision IDs
|   |   |   `-- view + nodeOrigins + optional transactionId
|   |   |-- diagramRevisions[id] -> retained revision records
|   |   `-- canvasViews -> named recordings outside the state restored by undo
|   |-- [D] Checkpoint composition + diagramBindings + revisions -> document()
|   |-- diagramRevisionStore.ts exposes createStoredDiagram / reviseStoredDiagram
|   |   `-- Internal revisionRegistry retains revisions; callers resolve by ID
|   |-- append / navigate / forkContext / adopt -> shared live and headless history
|   `-- prepareTransfer() / prepareTransferNavigation()
|       `-- Copy/move across canvases has linked transaction boundaries;

|
|-- [C,O] MappingEditorRuntime -- native interaction bridges to semantic commits
|   |   src/features/mapping/tldraw/MappingEditorRuntime.ts
|   |-- MappingEditorCanvas mounts tldraw Editor and attaches one editor driver
|   |-- [D] ControllerSnapshot -> projectMappingShapes() -> mapping-box shapes
|   |   `-- publish() synchronizes shapes, selection and mappingCheckpoint metadata
|   |-- Editor owns live geometry and undo navigation
|   |   `-- Pointer/camera frames do not write application document state
|   |-- settle() converts completed native changes into DiagramOperation[]
|   |   `-- commitEditorGesture(operations, canvas) -> one semantic checkpoint
|   |-- Native undo/redo changes mappingCheckpoint
|   |   `-- restoreEditorCheckpoint(id) -> archived document and view
|   |       `-- Without an editor, controller.undo() navigates domain history directly
|   `-- dispose() settles outstanding geometry and removes listeners/driver
|
|-- [C] Agent-assisted editing -- asynchronous producers use the same controller
|   |-- PromptComposerCoordinator [src/features/mapping/prompt-composer/]
|   |   |-- Owns entries, drafts, captured requests and polling timers
|   |   |-- submit() -> client.capture() -> pinned version + baseRevisionId
|   |   `-- client.start() / status() / cancel(); retry reuses the exact request
|   |       `-- Composer lifetime is independent of selection, panel visibility and undo
|   |-- DiagramEditService [application/mapping/agent/diagramEditService.ts]
|   |   |-- Owns runs and request-ID deduplication; generates then installs a revision
|   |   |-- [D] Captured canvas + pinned prompt references + AgentContext -> generation
|   |   `-- DiagramEditCanvasPort.apply()/create() -> live canvas command transport
|   |-- useAgentCanvasBridge [src/features/mapping/agent/useAgentCanvasBridge.ts]
|   |   |-- Registers canvas, polls commands, invokes page handler and returns replies
|   |   `-- Cleanup aborts polling and unregisters the ephemeral canvas instance
|   `-- DiagramRevisionReceiver.apply()/batch()
|       |   src/features/mapping/agent/diagramRevisionReceiver.ts
|       |-- Expected canvas version + base revision -> controller.applyUpdate()
|       |-- Retain request receipt before persistence -> avoid editing twice on retry
|       `-- Persist/flush before acknowledgement; failed flush -> PERSISTENCE_PENDING

`-- [O,C] Workspace persistence -- committed records outlive browser sessions
    |-- Startup [src/features/mapping/MappingPage.tsx]
    |   `-- loadProjectRepresentations('current') + WorkspaceStorage.load()
    |       `-- Restore/reconcile drafts -> CanvasWorkspace.setDrafts()

    |   `-- [D] History delta + metadata + baseline + personal view -> record batch

    |-- RecordStorage -> WorkspaceStorage -> workspaceStorage.worker.ts
    |   |   src/features/mapping/workspace/
    |   |-- Coalesce pending keys; retain one in-flight batch
    |   |-- requestId + expectedRevision -> retry identity and optimistic concurrency
    |   |-- Worker encodes records and POSTs /api/mapping/workspace/records

    `-- WorkspaceRecordStore.apply() [infrastructure/mapping/persistence/workspace/]
